# Grace Ashdown

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c2 P25](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0025), [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Juneford  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>

## Appearance

Grace is a striking beauty with long, flowing curls. She has a high-spirited, cheerful, and creative demeanor, though she occasionally acts with hasty audacity.

_Sources: [v5 c21 P6](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0006), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

## Personality

Grace is bold, rash, impulsive, and brimming with spirit, often acting immediately upon her decisions. She has short-lived fits of temper but quickly returns to good humor, lacking any malice. Highly sensitive to insults, she is easily wounded by cruel remarks yet remains loyal and deeply sympathetic toward others. She is also quick to laugh, unbothered by unconventional fun, and acts with courageous determination when she believes she is fixing a problem.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 c11 P24](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0024), [v5 c12 P9](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0009), [v5 c12 P28](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0028), [v5 c16 P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c20 P1](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0001), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

- impulsive and decisive  <sub>[v5 c16 P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000)</sub>
- sensitive to insults  <sub>[v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026)</sub>

## Goals

- fix issues and help her family  <sub>[v5 c15 P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c20 P1](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0001)</sub>

## History

After moving to Glen St. Agnes with her family, Grace enjoyed the freedom of a manse managed without strict domestic training. She frequently shared clothes with guests like Mary Stubbs and engaged in bold antics. When her father faced public gossip, Grace undertook sudden initiatives, such as attempting to clean the house—which accidentally occurred on a Sunday due to a mistaken day count—and marching up to the pulpit platform during church service to give a public explanation. She also challenged Edmund Carrow to ride a pig through Glen St. Agnes and went directly to the feared Lionel Fairlie to persuade him to return to church. When Dan Coyle insulted her, Edmund fought him to defend her honor. To avoid further embarrassment to their father, Grace and her siblings formed the Good-Conduct Club to manage and punish their own misdeeds. After a misunderstanding regarding a grave marker, she published a defiant public clarification in the local newspaper. She eventually sought comfort in Clementine Ainslie, forming a warm bond that welcomed Clementine into her family's life.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c5 P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087), [v5 c10 P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 c11 P17](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0017), [v5 c11 P22](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0022), [v5 c12 P1](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0001), [v5 c12 P5](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0005), [v5 c12 P9](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0009), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c17 P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), [v5 c17 P43](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0043), [v5 c20 P38](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0038), [v5 c24 P0](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0000), [v5 c25 P25](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Lived in Juneford before moving to the Glen St. Agnes manse  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- Daughter of Rev. John Knox Ashdown and the late Cecilia Ashdown  <sub>[v5 c2 P25](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0025), [v5 c6 P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 c14 P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018)</sub>
- Kept a tamed rooster while living in Juneford  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>

> I have no desire to resemble everyone else. Being me suits me better, as it is far more engaging.  <sub>[v5 c10 P23](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0023)</sub>

> I am heading across to Hollowmere so I can speak with Mrs. Carrow. Unlike all the others, she will not mock me. I simply must speak to someone who comprehends the depth of my distress.  <sub>[v5 c20 P1](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0001)</sub>

> FOR THE ATTENTION OF THOSE AFFECTED:  <sub>[v5 c25 P26](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0026)</sub>

> With respect, “GRACE ASHDOWN.”  <sub>[v5 c25 P31](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0031)</sub>
